name: hearth-control
description: A local macOS control center for a desktop MCP workflow.
author: Hearth Control

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:5173 && node scripts/restore-stable-build-meta.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:metadata && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test:github: node --test scripts/test-github-client.mjs scripts/test-github-connections.mjs scripts/test-github-mcp-tools.mjs scripts/test-github-main-boundary.mjs scripts/test-github-http-transport.mjs
scripts.test:vercel: node --test scripts/test-vercel-client.mjs scripts/test-vercel-connections.mjs scripts/test-vercel-mcp-tools.mjs scripts/test-vercel-main-boundary.mjs scripts/test-vercel-http-transport.mjs
scripts.test:market: node --test scripts/test-market-specialists.mjs scripts/test-market-swing-core.mjs scripts/test-market-smc-idm.mjs scripts/test-market-harmonic-prz.mjs scripts/test-market-technical-signal.mjs scripts/test-market-outcome-tracker.mjs scripts/test-mt5-risk-data-plane.mjs scripts/test-mt5-risk-ea-source.mjs scripts/test-mt5-demo-executor-transport.mjs scripts/test-mt5-demo-executor-ea-source.mjs scripts/test-demo-auto-executor.mjs scripts/test-demo-risk-config.mjs scripts/test-live-v2-coordinator.mjs scripts/test-market-risk-e2e.mjs scripts/test-market-demo-execution-e2e.mjs scripts/test-market-risk-gate.mjs scripts/test-market-pipeline.mjs scripts/test-market-live-runtime.mjs scripts/test-market-lean-synthesis.mjs scripts/test-market-mt5-e2e.mjs scripts/test-market-router.mjs scripts/test-market-main-boundary.mjs scripts/test-invest-mode-controller.mjs scripts/test-invest-monitor.mjs scripts/test-invest-ui-boundary.mjs scripts/test-mt5-bridge-server.mjs scripts/test-mt5-bridge-main-boundary.mjs scripts/test-mt5-ea-source.mjs scripts/test-mt5-setup-detection.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.package:update: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 && node scripts/generate-update-manifest.cjs
